PURPOSE
 إرسال ومتابعة الرسائل داخل الجمرك

MODULE DESCRIPTION
.
The following definition will be used :
-----------------------------------------
1-The message header(MSG_HDR) is created by the business module and it will be referred as "message".
2-The message owner (MSG_OWNER) is created by the business module and will be referred as "owner".
3-The message actions.(MSG_ACTN) is created whenever an action is taken on the message and will be referred as action.
4-When the word "user" appears in the text it means the "user id" or the user class "class_cd".
The only exception where user means user id are:
-The message creator in "MSG_HDR"
-The "send to" in "MSG_ACTN"

General Rules:
--------------
1-The user can work only on enabled document types & message types.
2-The followings are passed to the report at setup(the user will not enter them) :
 The document type (ex.: 0 for all،1for manifest , 2 for IS))
 The message direction (equals 1 in this case"Internal")

Screen:
-------
The user will see the screen as 2 parts:
1-The first part will contain the message header information and the owner information,
 he can query the details by pressing a button.
2-The second part will contain the actions taken on the message
3-He can scroll in the 2 parts

Rules for querying the messages:
--------------------------------
The user can query the messages, message details, owners, and actions in the following cases:
1-Created by him (through the business module)
2-Owned by him (his name or class are in "MSG_OWNER" ).
3-Owned by many users (his name or class are in the list of "MSG_OWNER" )
4-Owned by anonymous (no owner(no instances in "MSG_OWNER" ).

The user can query the messages, message details, owners, and ONLY the actions that he is a part of it :
1-Forwarded to him (he is the destination )
6-Replied by him
7-Sent by him

From the queried messages and actions, the user can perform actions according to the followings:
==============================================================================
SEND "إرسال"
Transferring the ownership of a message to another user
--------------------------------------------------------
 IF(the current user is the owner AND (message status is "new" OR "under processing") AND (no actions found OR "send" actions found))
 {
 DELETE all instances in MSG_OWNER
 INSERT an instance with his name in MSG_OWNER // for recalling purpose
 INSERT an instance with the destination user in MSG_OWNER
 INSERT a “send action” in MSG_ACTN with his name as a "sender from" and the destination user as a "send to"
 IF (the message was sent to him by another user i.e. an instance in
 MSG_ACTN exists with his name as a destination )
 {
 UPDATE the successor of the inserted "send" action instant in "MSG_ACTN " with the predecessor action
 }
 IF(msg_status="new") change it to "under processing"
 }

=====================================================================================
Forward "تحويل لعمل اللازم"
forward the message to the intended business unit
-------------------------------------------------
IF(the current user is the owner AND (message status is "new" OR "under processing"))
 {
 INSERT a “forward action” in MSG_ACTN with his name as a "sender from" and the destination user as a "send to"
 IF (the message was sent to him by another user i.e. an instance in
 MSG_ACTN exists with the owner user as a destination )
 {
 UPDATE the successor of the inserted "forward" action instant in "MSG_ACTN " with the predecessor action
 }
 IF(msg_status="new") change it to "under processing"
 }
=====================================================================================
Reply "إجابة"
Reply to forwarded action
---------------------------
IF( (a "forward" action exists with "send to"=current user) AND (message status is "new" OR "under processing") )
 {
 INSERT a “reply action” in MSG_ACTN with "sender from"=current user & "send to"= the "send from" of the found "forward" action
 UPDATE the successor of the inserted "reply" action instant in "MSG_ACTN " with the predecessor action
 }
=====================================================================================
Recall "إعادة"
Reacll the message before the destination user takes actions
------------------------------------------------------------
IF( an action exists with "send from"=current user) AND (no successor action exists) AND (message status is "new" OR "under processing") ))
 {
 IF (the recalled action was "send")
 {
 DELETE all instances in MSG_OWNER
 INSERT an instance with his name in MSG_OWNER
 INSERT a “recall action” in MSG_ACTN with sender from"=current user & "send to"= current user
 UPDATE the successor of the inserted "reply" action instant in "MSG_ACTN " with the predecessor action
 }

 IF (the recalled action was "forward" OR "reply")
 {
 INSERT a “recall action” in MSG_ACTN with the destination user=his name
 INSERT a “recall action” in MSG_ACTN with sender from"=current user & "send to"= current user
 UPDATE the successor of the inserted "reply" action instant in "MSG_ACTN " with the predecessor action
 }
 }
=====================================================================================
Approve/Reject the message "تم تنفيذ المطلوب في الرسالة\رفضه"
--------------------------------------------
IF(the current user is the owner AND (message status is "new" OR "under processing") AND all "forward" actions are replyed)
 {
 INSERT a “completed action” in MSG_ACTN with no successor
 Chang the message status to Approved/rejected and write free text
 }
=====================================================================================
Approve/Reject and message notifid "تم تنفيذ المطلوب في الرسالة\رفضه وتم إعلام منشأ الرسالة"
-----------------------------------------------------------------
//This can be done from this screen or automatically from th Business module
IF(current user= message creator AND message status is approved/rejected)
 {
 Chang the message status to Approved&notified/rejected&notified and write free text
 }
=====================================================================================

END IF;

/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'MHDR_XD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'DECREE_ISN,DECREE_PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MHDR_VMFSTS_FK') THEN

FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;
